results.title: LAST CALL
results.overview: Andrés, a young man desperately trying to reach his father. With every unanswered call, his frustration grows, transforming the silence into an echo of all the things left unsaid.

results.title: A Rose for Iris
results.overview: On the shores of England, a teenage girl witnesses her father's cruelty toward a migrant who has just arrived by small boat, forcing her to confront the complexities of both her father and the world around her.

results.title: The Final Embrace: 'Chi come me'
results.overview: This documentary explores the phenomenon behind Chi come me, a hit theatrical production directed by Andrée Ruth Shammah and written by Roy Chen. Following its final sold-out run at Milan's Teatro Franco Parenti, the film examines how a powerful story about five fragile teenagers in a mental health center finding their voice through theater transformed into an intergenerational cult experience and a profound mirror of contemporary adolescent struggles.

results.title: Red Screen
results.overview: A young and ambitious female profiler is trying to interrogate a maniac about his last victim, who might still be alive. However, the serial killer remains unresponsive. The only way to make him talk is to expose him to an effective yet deadly development called "Red Screen." There's just one problem-the profiler has to be the first one to experience "Red Screen".

results.title: La Partenza
results.overview: In a peaceful Italian town, a mother prepares her family for a long awaited trip to New York, carrying every responsibility on her own. As the pressure mounts, her inner world begins to fracture, revealing the invisible weight she can no longer hold alone.

results.title: Gecko
results.overview: When Niu Niu discovers her grandfather’s hidden past in Indonesia  through old letters and archives, she unravels the story of the family he  left behind and becomes entangled in a myth surrounding the local  animal Gecko.

results.title: Rumah Tanpa Luka Raya
results.overview: Kalsum and Qiuzi's marriage is now haunted by Hayden's return to win Kalsum's heart.

results.title: Reprisal
results.overview: This is NOT your average revenge story. A sniper's scope searches along a busy promenade - settling on a man in his 30's. Then a call from her husband threatens to upend this housewife's plan for revenge.

results.title: Pere Gimferrer. Retrat d'un artista adolescent
results.original_title: Pere Gimferrer. Retrat d'un artista adolescent

results.title: Ulysse
results.overview: Alice, a sociology researcher, and Volodymyr, a pianist, are going to have a child! They will call him Ulysses. Except that Ulysses, at one year old, doesn't fit the growth charts. Too small, too thin, and he still isn't walking. The verdict comes down: Ulysses won't be like the others. But how will he be?

results.title: The Ink-Stained Hand and the Missing Thumb
results.original_title: The Ink-Stained Hand and the Missing Thumb
results.overview: If the world had an edge, it might look something like the remote corner of northern India where Santosh and Rajji live, collecting highway tolls in dilapidated booths. Work and endless waiting are blurred together. Bound by the power of love, but also by the need to constantly move around in search of work, they dream of the happiness that awaits them in a new place… until one day, a sudden tragedy turns their lives upside down.

results.title: Hippo Love
results.overview: Two strangers meet at a Greek-Finnish wedding while going through their own breakups. Touko, a musician who has had little success and is still married, feels attracted to Eevis, who is in the process of getting divorced. Touko's wife, the famous singer Leena, is also a guest at the wedding and notices the attraction between Touko and Eevis. Amidst the stunning Greek seascapes, the conversations that take place over the course of one evening touch on parenthood, childlessness, sex, divorce, marriage, and, of course, love, while the guests celebrate a memorable wedding.

results.title: The Masturbator - The Adventures of Edgar Hilsenrath
results.original_title: The Masturbator - The Adventures of Edgar Hilsenrath
results.overview: This hybrid animated documentary plunges us into the transgressive world of Edgar Hilsenrath, the first German Jewish writer to dare to laugh in the face of the worst. His monumental work, inspired by his experience of the Holocaust, includes seminal titles such as * The Nazi and the Barber* (1971) and *Fuck America* (1980). His masterpiece * Night* , published in the United States in 1976 and an immediate success, was first published in Germany in 1964 before being withdrawn from sale by the publisher due to its explicit content. It remained censored in Germany for nearly 20 years. Without embellishment, detours, or circumlocutions, Hilsenrath's work is that of magnificent losers and inglorious wanderings. It is the incisive acuity of the marginalized on the depths of the human experience.

results.title: Dream Stall
results.overview: When her father (Mark Lee) decides to shut down You & Me Bak Kut Teh, their family bak kut teh hawker business, top-scoring university graduate Enya (Annette Lee) takes it upon herself to save it.  She successfully persuades her childhood friends Tammy (Xixi Lim) and Ahji (Jaspers Lai) to quit their jobs and join her in reopening business, but their endeavour gets off to a bad start when famous local actress Estella Tsai (Ya Hui), with the help of her manager Doreen (Cassandra See), open a restaurant next to them, selling the exact same dish.  Determined not to lose to her newfound rivals, Enya feigns interest in a food documentary YouTuber, Preston (Xander Pang) — who has a reputation of saving local F&B businesses with his videos but only does so pro-bono. Will she succeed in keeping the shop alive?

results.title: Cleaver 3: Maximum Cleavage
results.overview: Locked away in a maximum security prison, the infamous killer clown Mary Beth Layton, a.k.a. Lil Miss Cleaver, is about to make a prison break that no one will forget.

results.title: Best Boy
results.overview: After the death of their abusive and tyrannic father, three children – now adults – and their aging mother return to their long-abandoned summer cottage. They will have to partake in a strange competition that tore their family apart 30 years prior – a nightmarish return to the past for the family's children.

results.title: Micro Budget
results.overview: A mockumentary about an absolute moron attempting to make an independent film.

results.title: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!
results.overview: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.
